correctness.rationale: Modulo u coprime to 6, A and B are finite permutations, inverses are forward powers, and (AB)(BA)^{-1} translates by 2, covering u. Modulo 3N for odd N, C, AB and B hit each of the three families given full projection at N, so every odd modulus is full. Applying A reaches all even classes at m=2·3^b·u. Every odd word must end in a last C followed only by j copies of B, giving x+1=2·3^j(3s+2); for j<b the normalized ternary unit is 1 modulo 3, for j>=b it is in the terminal residue. Conversely an allowed j<b class fixes s modulo the odd 3^(b−j−1)u, which is attained. For the terminal class j=b gives all u lifts because 3 is invertible modulo u. Shells are disjoint, sizes sum to u(3^(b+1)+1)/2, and the inverse-limit odd slice has mass sum of 3^(−j−1)=1/2 (the limit point has mass zero). Together with the full even slice the Haar mass is 3/4; it is not integer density. Independent fixed-point set checks for m=6,18,378,4050,16038 confirmed the full predicted images (sizes 5,14,287,3050,12034), via python3 /workspace/branches/independent-reproduction/arithmetic_review.py.
